summary: Warfarin for a mechanical mitral valve before elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy: bridging (high thromboembolic risk), marked borderline.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Recurrent upper abdominal pain after meals
inputs.hpi: Three episodes of right upper quadrant pain after fatty meals over 6 months, each settling within hours. Ultrasound shows gallstones. Mechanical mitral valve replacement 2015 on warfarin.
